**Lemma 1 (every value lands in $\mathbb F_{2^{18}}$).**

The Frobenius $\Phi\colon\alpha\mapsto\alpha^{2^{18}}$ generates $\mathrm{Gal}(\mathbb F_{2^{36}}/\mathbb F_{2^{18}})$. For any $f$ with $\mathbb F_2$‑coefficients that is invariant under $(x,y)\mapsto(x^{-1},y^{-1})$,
$$f(\zeta^j,\zeta^k)^{2^{18}}=f(\zeta^{2^{18}j},\zeta^{2^{18}k})=f(\zeta^{-j},\zeta^{-k})=f(\zeta^j,\zeta^k),$$

**Lemma 2 (cube ⇔ norm‑one).**
